dimension_note: The load-bearing axis is intent: the same nouns (prompt, system prompt, judge) appear when someone wants the WORDS of a prompt written or changed (this skill), when they want something MEASURED — an eval set up, a judge calibrated, two models compared (eval), when they want a SKILL.md or an instruction file written (the repository's own standards), or when they are only talking about prompting. Negative controls come from the doors that own those phrasings.
coverage: 10 positives across five surfaces and three arrivals; 11 negatives: 4 eval decoys, 2 adjacent standards (skill body, instruction file), 2 meta discussion, 2 plain coding/config tasks that mention a prompt file, 1 status question.
